notes: Ethereum stables only · not exhaustive · hover, focus or tap a venue APY to see every source behind it.
DeFiLlama’s borrow-rate history (chartLendBorrow) is a paid endpoint, so the 30-day check is the pool’s 30-day mean APY minus this week’s benchmark.

(b) Membrane carry has no borrow term: debt deployed in a canonical venue is paid for with a curator-set share of that venue’s yield, not a borrow rate. With no curator share given it is an upper bound.
Positive carry means the spread measured at this scan, never a promise.
/carry route "USDC → Morpho Vault V2" is a class of 33 vaults: none is hidden; a scout row on one of them says “also behind /carry route USDC → Morpho Vault V2”.
/carry route "PYUSD → Morpho Vault V2" is a class of 3 vaults: none is hidden; a scout row on one of them says “also behind /carry route PYUSD → Morpho Vault V2”.

/carry route "USDC → Compound" resolves to no specific contract (no Compound destination in the seed: Compound v3 (Comet) is not an ERC-4626 vault, so the A+B vault seed has none. It counts as nothing).
venueApyRule: Vault APYs (MetaMorpho, Morpho Vault V2, other ERC-4626) are an average of their sources, like for like: base = mean of DeFiLlama apyBase, Morpho’s net APY without rewards and the on-chain 7-day share-price growth; with rewards = that base mean + the mean reward of the sources that report one (DeFiLlama apy − apyBase, Morpho netApy − its no-rewards figure). A missing source is left out, never counted as 0. At a size the average is × TVL/(TVL+size). Lending reserves are priced on-chain; every other row is DeFiLlama’s.
